manifest.name: QR Share
manifest.description: A QR code of every page's address, behind a small button or as a card at the bottom, and on printed pages. Generated on your server as inline SVG: no image service, no tracking.

panels.title: QR code
panels.description: A QR code that opens the current page on a phone. It is made on your server; nothing loads from another site.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show QR codes
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: placement
fields.title: Where
fields.description: A round button that opens the code, or a card at the bottom of every page.

choices.title: Card at the bottom of the page

fields.name: side
fields.title: Button side
fields.description: Which bottom corner the button sits in.

fields.name: heading
fields.title: Heading
fields.description: The line next to the code. Leave it empty for no heading.

fields.name: accent
fields.title: Button colour
fields.description: The round button and the download button. The code itself is always black on white, so every phone can read it.

fields.name: print
fields.title: Print the code
fields.description: With the button, also print the code at the bottom of printed pages. Handy for posters and menus.

fields.name: download
fields.title: Download button
fields.description: Lets visitors save the code as an SVG file, sharp at any size.

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Never on
fields.description: Slugs separated by commas. A trailing * matches a prefix, e.g. "legal/*".

fields.name: site-address
fields.title: Site address
fields.description: e.g. https://example.com. Optional: learned when you publish on a domain. Without an address pages are left as they are.

store.tagline: A QR code of every page, for phones, posters and menus. Made on your server.
store.longDescription:
QR Share gives every page a QR code of its own address, so a visitor can open it on their phone in one scan.

By default a small round button sits in the bottom corner. A click opens a card with the code, the address and a Download QR code button. Print the page and the code is at the bottom of the paper, which turns any page into a poster, a flyer, a menu or a price card that leads back to your site. Prefer it always visible? Show it as a card at the bottom of every page instead.

The code is made by the plugin on your own server, as a sharp inline SVG. There is no QR image service, no script from another site and no tracking: nothing is fetched from anyone else, before or after a visitor clicks.

It needs no setup on a site with a domain: the address is learned when you publish. You can also set it yourself, and a page's own canonical link always wins. The code is black on white with error correction that survives a smudge, and uses the smallest size that fits.

It is accessible: a real keyboard-friendly button that works without JavaScript, Escape to close, a visible focus ring, the code labelled with the address it opens and that address shown as text.

It asks for one permission, storage, to keep its settings and your site's address. Refuse it and pages with a full canonical link still get their code.
